facts.text: Parsonsburg is part of the Salisbury, Maryland‑Delaware Metropolitan Statistical Area, linking it to a larger regional economy and community network.
Parsonsburg experiences hot, humid summers that bring lush greenery and occasional thunderstorms, a hallmark of the Mid‑Atlantic climate.
Winters in Parsonsburg are generally mild to cool, allowing residents to enjoy outdoor activities without extreme cold.
According to the Köppen climate classification, Parsonsburg falls under the humid subtropical category, abbreviated as Cfa on climate maps.
Parsonsburg observes daylight savings time, shifting clocks forward in spring and back in fall to make better use of daylight.
During winter months, residents follow Eastern Standard Time, aligning their schedules with the rest of the Mid‑Atlantic region.
